Class I18n

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.i18n.I18n
public final class I18n extends Object
Immutable message catalogue and preference normalisation helpers for servlet/JSP views.

Message keys follow a dotted naming scheme (for example settings.title, msg.appSubmitted). English texts are authoritative for missing translations: message(String, String) falls back first to English, then to the key string so diagnostics remain visible.

resolveLanguage(HttpServletRequest) and resolveAppearance(HttpServletRequest) pick the active preference in this order: request-scope attribute named "language" / "appearance", persisted fields on User when present in session, matching session attributes, finally "en" / "light".

  • Method Details

    • normalizeLanguage

      public static String normalizeLanguage(String language)
      Collapses arbitrary user input to one of the supported language codes.
      Parameters:
      language - raw token (may be null)
      Returns:
      "zh" when the argument matches Chinese (case-insensitive); otherwise "en"

    • normalizeAppearance

      public static String normalizeAppearance(String appearance)
      Collapses arbitrary user input to one of the supported theme tokens.
      Parameters:
      appearance - raw token (may be null)
      Returns:
      "dark" when the argument matches dark mode (case-insensitive); otherwise "light"

    • isChinese

      public static boolean isChinese(String language)
      Parameters:
      language - raw language tag before normalisation
      Returns:
      true when normalizeLanguage(String) yields "zh"

    • langTag

      public static String langTag(String language)
      Produces a BCP 47 language tag suitable for HTML lang attributes.
      Parameters:
      language - raw or normalised language token
      Returns:
      zh-CN for Chinese UI, otherwise en

    • messagesFor

      public static Map<String,String> messagesFor(String language)
      Exposes the backing map for the requested locale.
      Parameters:
      language - raw or normalised language token
      Returns:
      ZH_MESSAGES for Chinese UI, otherwise EN_MESSAGES; callers must not mutate the map

    • message

      public static String message(String language, String key)
      Looks up a translated string, applying the English fallback policy described in the class documentation.
      Parameters:
      language - active UI language (normalised by normalizeLanguage(String) at call sites when needed)
      key - dotted message identifier
      Returns:
      translated text, or English if the key is missing in the active map, or key when still unknown

    • resolveLanguage

      public static String resolveLanguage(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req)
      Derives the active UI language for the current request by consulting request attributes, session state, and user profile.
      Parameters:
      req - current HTTP request; null yields "en"
      Returns:
      normalised language code suitable for message(String, String)

    • resolveAppearance

      public static String resolveAppearance(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req)
      Derives the active theme for the current request using the same precedence rules as resolveLanguage(HttpServletRequest) (request attribute, persisted user preference, session attribute, default).
      Parameters:
      req - current HTTP request; null yields "light"
      Returns:
      normalised theme token ("light" or "dark")
